tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier that owns this key

name.description: Human-readable label for the API key

api_key.description: Optional imported credential; absent or empty generates a new key. Imports require 16-512 printable non-space ASCII bytes. GET/list never returns the credential. Create currently emits an empty raw_key string for imports, not omission. Length and invalid-character rejections both map to 400 with api_key validation fields.

allowed_models.description: List of model identifiers this key may access

rate_limit_rps.description: Maximum requests per second allowed for this key

burst_size.description: Total request-bucket capacity, not additional capacity above RPS. Zero uses per-key RPS. Nonpositive RPS skips this limiter; negative-value validation remains incomplete.

tokens_per_min.description: Per-key token quota in the supported token-accounting data plane. Positive values participate in admission reservation and usage settlement; nonpositive values leave this dimension unlimited. Insufficient reservation capacity returns 429 token_quota_would_exceed with Retry-After before backend delivery. Tenant, model, user and service quotas are separate dimensions. Readback alone does not prove effective enforcement for a particular service or protocol.

expires_at.description: Optional RFC3339 expiry. Omitted, zero-time, or Unix-epoch values mean no expiry in this handler. Other past timestamps are accepted, so successful creation does not establish a currently usable key.

enabled.description: Whether the API key is active. Absent = enabled (optional, nullable to distinguish unset).

client_op_id.description: Optional idempotency handle, at most 128 printable non-space ASCII characters, unique per tenant (a UUID the client minted for this create). A retry carrying the same value converges on the row the first request created instead of making a second key: while that key has never authenticated, its secret is minted again and delivered with the same key_id (reused=true); once it has, 409 api_key_already_delivered. Also accepted as the Idempotency-Key header. Absent, the create behaves as before and a retry after a 504 must first read the listing back.

priority_class.description: The highest priority class a request with this key may have. It can only lower what the key's tenant allows (a tenant that sets no class allows standard). Omitted means no cap from the key.

default_objective.description: The objective a request with this key gets when it names none, or one it may not use. Counts only when the tenant's allowed_objectives hold it.

allowed_objectives.description: The objectives a request with this key may ask for by header, and the body tiers (tier:priority, tier:fast, tier:flex) it may ask for by service_tier, out of the ones its tenant allows; at most 64. Empty means the key narrows nothing. The list governs raises only: a hint at or below what the request gets without one needs no entry.
